# National Center for State Courts (NCSC)

> > The National Center for State Courts provides research, resources, and training to improve state court administration, judicial excellence, and access to justice across the United States.

NCSC works with state courts, the Conference of State Court Administrators (COSCA), and judicial leaders to advance court technology, caseflow management, AI readiness, judicial security, and specialized areas like child welfare and guardianship. The organization offers training through the Institute for Court Management, publishes court statistics and best practices, and supports judicial innovation.

## Key Topics

- State courts
- Access to justice
- Court technology
- AI in courts
- Caseflow management
- Judicial security
- Court administration
- Judicial training
- Conference of State Court Administrators (COSCA)
- Institute for Court Management
- Court data and statistics
- Digital accessibility
- Child welfare courts
- Guardianship oversight
- Record relief and expungement

## Core Resources & Programs

- [Resources for courts](https://www.ncsc.org/resources-courts): NCSC Resource Library with tools for judicial administration challenges
- [Caseflow management](https://www.ncsc.org/resources-courts/operations-governance/caseflow-management): Expert resources on caseflow management and backlog reduction for courts
- [Data](https://www.ncsc.org/resources-courts/data): Court Statistics Project dashboards tracking state court caseload trends
- [Leadership & coaching](https://www.ncsc.org/our-expertise/leadership-coaching): Leadership training and coaching services for court professionals
- [Webinars](https://www.ncsc.org/education-events/webinars): Court administration webinars on AI, access to justice, and judicial training

## Court Technology & AI

- [Leveraging AI to reshape the future of courts](https://www.ncsc.org/resources-courts/leveraging-ai-reshape-future-courts): AI solutions for court document processing, analytics, chatbots, and portals
- [Guiding principles for court technology](https://www.ncsc.org/resources-courts/guiding-principles-court-technology): CCJ/COSCA principles for post-pandemic court technology and digital transformation
- [Building AI readiness in state courts](https://www.ncsc.org/event/building-ai-readiness-state-courts): Webinar on NCSC's AI Readiness guide and AI maturity spectrum for courts
- [CourtStack: transforming court technology through innovation](https://www.ncsc.org/event/courtstack-transforming-court-technology-through-innovation): Webinar on CourtStack development platform for judicial technology
- [Digital accessibility & the courts](https://www.ncsc.org/event/digital-accessibility-courts): Webinar on court website accessibility ahead of April 2026 federal deadline

## Judicial Security & Legislative Updates

- [U.S. Senate passes judicial security bill](https://www.ncsc.org/news/us-senate-passes-judicial-security-bill): U.S. Senate passes S.2379 establishing State Judicial Threat Intelligence Center
- [Texas Judge Julie Kocurek to receive William H. Rehnquist Award for Judicial Excellence](https://www.ncsc.org/news/texas-judge-julie-kocurek-receive-william-h-rehnquist-award-judicial-excellence): Judge Julie Kocurek named 29th Annual Rehnquist Award recipient by NCSC

## Specialized Court Operations

- [Jury management in high-profile cases](https://www.ncsc.org/resources-courts/jury-management-high-profile-cases): Guidance on jury selection, voir dire, and sequestration in high-profile trials
- [A guide to better remote dependency hearings](https://www.ncsc.org/resources-courts/guide-better-remote-dependency-hearings): Best practices for virtual dependency hearings in juvenile court
- [Tracking state record relief activities](https://www.ncsc.org/resources-courts/tracking-state-record-relief-activities): Court resources on expungement, record sealing, and criminal record relief
- [Centering lived expertise in child welfare reform](https://www.ncsc.org/resources-courts/centering-lived-expertise-child-welfare-reform): National Judicial Leadership Summit on integrating lived experience in child welfare
- [Maximizing your CMS for effective guardianship oversight](https://www.ncsc.org/event/maximizing-your-cms-effective-guardianship-oversight): Webinar on guardianship case management standards and CMS optimization

## Reference Guides

- [Judges' guide to youth mental health jargon](https://www.ncsc.org/resources-courts/judges-guide-youth-mental-health-jargon): Mental health terminology reference for judges handling juvenile cases

## Optional

- [State court job postings](https://www.ncsc.org/resources-courts/state-court-job-postings): CORA portal with interactive map of state court career opportunities
- [Catherine Zacharias](https://www.ncsc.org/people/catherine-zacharias): Catherine Zacharias consults on judicial ethics policy and training
